item.text:
Research dossier only; no score assigned.

**Reused Evidence**
REUSE_JSON: {"evidence_ids":["E0001"],"lenses":["7B.1"]}
E0001 is used only for baseline attribution: Scholz was federal chancellor in 2022, so the items below are tied to his office and conduct rather than Germany's general corruption environment.

**New Evidence**
1. Reuters reporting on the 19 August 2022 Hamburg hearing captures Scholz denying impropriety while opposition lawmakers accused him of obfuscation.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Grilling over Scholz's handling of multibillion-euro tax fraud ends in stand-off","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","publication_date":"2022-08-19","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy/germanys-scholz-to-testify-over-handling-of-multibillioneuro-tax-fraud-2876122","claim":"Hamburg lawmakers' questioning of Scholz over the Warburg tax-fraud affair ended without resolution; Scholz denied impropriety and opposition lawmakers accused him of obfuscating the truth.","locator":"line 420; lines 444-446","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Reuters wire reporting on a live parliamentary hearing with direct quotes from Scholz and named opposition reaction.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Directly in 2022 and about Scholz's own testimony.","ruler_attribution":"Strong for Scholz's own denial and stated lack of knowledge; limited for proving dishonesty because the article reports allegations, not a finding.","contrary_evidence":["Scholz denied any impropriety and said he had no knowledge of the cash or its origin.","No independent adjudication of falsehood is reported in the article."],"lenses":["7B.1","7B.2","7B.6","7B.8","7B.10"]}

2. tagesschau's contemporaneous account gives Scholz's own denial of influence and his claim that he still could not remember the content of the Warburg meetings.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Scholz vor Cum-Ex-Ausschuss: \"Habe keinen Einfluss genommen\"","publisher":"tagesschau.de","publication_date":"2022-08-19","url":"https://www.tagesschau.de/inland/scholz-cum-ex-105.html","claim":"Scholz again told the Hamburg inquiry he had taken no influence on the Warburg tax case and said he still could not remember the content of the meetings with bankers.","locator":"lines 153-156","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Public-service broadcaster reporting contemporaneous testimony with direct quotation.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Directly within 2022 and tied to Scholz's own words under parliamentary scrutiny.","ruler_attribution":"Strong for the utterance and refusal to recall; limited for truthfulness because the article does not independently prove the denial false.","contrary_evidence":["The same article notes that critics saw parts of his earlier 2020 statements as evidence he had remembered more than he later claimed.","No proof of political influence is established in the article."],"lenses":["7B.1","7B.2","7B.6","7B.8"]}

3. A Berlin court order reported by Tagesspiegel shows the chancellery being forced to disclose Scholz's personal knowledge about a Cum-Ex-related background conversation with journalists.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Gericht fordert Scholz zu Auskünften auf: Cum-Ex-Affäre erreicht Kanzleramt","publisher":"Tagesspiegel","publication_date":"2022-07-07","url":"https://www.tagesspiegel.de/politik/cum-ex-affare-erreicht-kanzleramt-scholz-schweigen-sagt-etwas-531234.html","claim":"Berlin's administrative court required the Kanzleramt to answer press requests about Scholz's personal knowledge of a 2020 Cum-Ex-related background conversation and rejected the office's confidentiality objection.","locator":"lines 294-313","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"medium_high","source_confidence_reason":"The article reports a specific court order and quotes the court's reasoning, but it is still a media account rather than the judgment itself.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Within 2022 and directly tied to Scholz's conduct as an incumbent federal officeholder responding to scrutiny about prior conduct.","ruler_attribution":"Medium to strong: the order concerns his office's response and his earlier personal knowledge, not a proven finding of deception.","contrary_evidence":["The appeal was still pending at the time of reporting.","The ruling addressed disclosure, not whether the underlying alleged statements were true or false."],"lenses":["7B.6","7B.7","7B.8"]}

4. Berlin's administrative court later ordered the Kanzleramt to disclose communication with media about the Cum-Ex affair, including questions about information on Scholz's involvement.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Bundeskanzleramt muss Auskünfte über Kommunikation mit Medien in der \"Cum-Ex-Affaire\" erteilen (Nr. 18/2023)","publisher":"Berlin.de / Verwaltungsgericht Berlin","publication_date":"2023-03-31","url":"https://www.berlin.de/gerichte/verwaltungsgericht/presse/pressemitteilungen/2023/pressemitteilung.1310512.php","claim":"The court held that the Bundeskanzleramt had to answer press questions about communication between the chief of the chancellery and journalists regarding the Cum-Ex affair, including questions touching Scholz's involvement.","locator":"lines 90-93","source_type":"legal","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Official court press release describing the operative holding and the scope of the requested disclosure.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Retrospective on the 2022 disclosure dispute and directly about official handling of Cum-Ex-related media questions.","ruler_attribution":"Medium: it concerns the chancellery under Scholz and a disclosure dispute about his circle, but it does not itself prove his personal deception.","contrary_evidence":["The ruling was about information access, not the underlying merits of the Cum-Ex allegations.","It does not establish that any concealed statement was false."],"lenses":["7B.6","7B.7"]}

5. The Bundestag's January 2023 finance-committee debate shows opposition claims that Scholz's statements contained contradictions and that the committee was asked to summon him again.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Herbeirufung des Bundeskanzlers abgelehnt","publisher":"Deutscher Bundestag","publication_date":"2023-01-18","url":"https://www.bundestag.de/presse/hib/kurzmeldungen-929732","claim":"The finance committee rejected an opposition motion to summon Scholz; CDU/CSU said declassified records revealed contradictions in his earlier statements, while coalition parties said no new findings justified further action.","locator":"lines 737-739","source_type":"official","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Official parliamentary summary of committee positions and the grounds for the motion.","final_evidence_use":"context","period_fit":"Retrospective on 2022 scrutiny and earlier statements; not a direct 2022 act, but a live follow-on to that period.","ruler_attribution":"Medium: it concerns Scholz's own statements under scrutiny, but the article records allegations and procedure, not a factual finding of lying.","contrary_evidence":["SPD/Greens/FDP said the protocol revealed no new insights and no further summons was needed.","No parliamentary finding of deliberate deception is reported."],"lenses":["7B.1","7B.2","7B.6"]}

6. A Bundestag hearing in June 2023 on a proposed Cum-Ex investigative committee shows that Scholz's role and contacts with Warburg remained under parliamentary examination.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Anhörung zum beantragten Cum-Ex-Untersuchungsausschuss","publisher":"Deutscher Bundestag","publication_date":"2023-06-19","url":"https://www.bundestag.de/presse/hib/kurzmeldungen-954232","claim":"The Bundestag held an official hearing on a proposed Cum-Ex investigative committee that focused on Scholz's role as former Hamburg mayor and on contacts between Warburg representatives and Scholz or his city officials.","locator":"lines 734-739","source_type":"official","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Official parliamentary hearing notice summarizing the scope of the proposed inquiry.","final_evidence_use":"context","period_fit":"Retrospective on 2022 integrity scrutiny; it does not add direct 2022 facts but confirms the issue remained live.","ruler_attribution":"Medium: it concerns the ruler's prior conduct and network, but the page is a procedural notice rather than a merits finding.","contrary_evidence":["The notice does not establish that Scholz acted improperly.","It describes the proposed inquiry, not its outcome."],"lenses":["7B.6","7B.7"]}

7. Tagesschau reported in April 2023 that Hamburg prosecutors found no initial suspicion of false testimony against Scholz.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Cum-Ex-Untersuchungsausschuss: Darum geht es beim Warburg-Skandal","publisher":"tagesschau.de","publication_date":"2023-04-04","url":"https://www.tagesschau.de/inland/innenpolitik/warburg-bank-scholz-101.html","claim":"Hamburg prosecutors concluded there was no initial suspicion against Scholz for false testimony in relation to his statements in the various parliamentary committees.","locator":"lines 181-181 and 173-181","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Public-service broadcaster summarizing the prosecutorial threshold and the committee's legal background.","final_evidence_use":"final_evidence","period_fit":"Retrospective on the 2022 testimony dispute; it does not change the underlying 2022 event but informs how later scrutiny treated it.","ruler_attribution":"Strong enough to the specific testimony dispute, but only at the criminal-threshold level; it is not a full innocence finding.","contrary_evidence":["The same article notes that critics still considered his memory lapses potentially incriminating.","A lack of prosecutorial suspicion is not the same as proof of truthful testimony."],"lenses":["7B.2","7B.6","7B.7"]}

8. Scholz publicly announced an assets register and a whistleblower hotline in June 2022 as part of sanctions / anti-money-laundering enforcement.
SOURCE_CLAIM_JSON: {"title":"Germany to create assets register to improve sanctions efforts, says Scholz","publisher":"Reuters via Euronews","publication_date":"2022-06-15","url":"https://www.euronews.com/2022/06/15/uk-germany-sanctions","claim":"Scholz announced that Germany would establish a national register for assets of unclear origin and a special hotline for whistleblowers.","locator":"lines 601-603","source_type":"media","source_confidence":"high","source_confidence_reason":"Reuters wire reporting a specific policy announcement made by Scholz at a formal meeting.","final_evidence_use":"context","period_fit":"Directly within 2022, but it is a policy signal rather than evidence of personal honesty or misconduct.","ruler_attribution":"Medium: this is Scholz's public anti-corruption stance, but it is a policy promise, not proof of personal integrity in practice.","contrary_evidence":["The announcement does not show implementation or personal compliance.","A transparency pledge is not the same as demonstrated conduct."],"lenses":["7B.6","7B.10"]}

**Search and Rejection Summary**
I reviewed roughly 30-plus documents across Reuters syndications, tagesschau, Tagesspiegel, Bundestag notices, Hamburg parliamentary pages, Berlin court releases, WELT, Euronews, and a few commentary/opinion items. I kept the evidence centered on the one personal-integrity episode that is actually documentable in 2022: Cum-Ex / Warburg scrutiny, courtroom disclosure fights, and official anti-corruption signaling.

Rejected or downgraded items included:
- Duplicate Reuters syndications and near-identical retellings of the same 19 August 2022 hearing.
- Opinion/commentary pieces from ZEIT, Tagesspiegel, and similar outlets that accused Scholz of memory lapses or lying but did not add independent findings.
- The SPD Hamburg press release on the Cum-Ex hearing because it is partisan framing, not an independent finding.
- Ukraine, energy, Bundeswehr fund, and general governance items that did not have a direct personal-integrity nexus.
- Out-of-period retrospective pages from 2024-2026 that were not needed to establish the 2022 record.
- Generic corruption-index / institutional-quality context from the local prior, which I treated as background only and did not cite as evidence.

**Remaining Gaps**
- There is still no direct, independently verified evidence of personal enrichment, family/business conflicts, gifts, or nepotism for Scholz in 2022.
- The Cum-Ex material remains a mixed record: there are repeated allegations of contradiction and obfuscation, but no definitive finding that he lied.
- The best next step, if a finer integrity judgment were ever needed, would be the primary 2022 Hamburg PUA transcript and the underlying Bundestag finanzausschuss protocol, not more commentary.
- More search could sharpen the line between honest memory failure and strategic evasion, but it is unlikely to produce a dramatically different picture unless a new primary record surfaces.
